verdict.rationale: The Swift SDK documents native tool calling: you register a tool and its function, and the SDK runs the call-and-execute loop and detects the tool format the model expects. Structured output with schema validation is also documented, and the hosted endpoint is OpenAI-compatible. Nothing ties tool calling to requests on that serving endpoint, and reasoning-parser support is never mentioned. Hands-on reports of small models claiming actions they didn't perform point to unreliable tool execution in the rcli demo. missing for 10: reasoning-parser support, documented tool-calling parameters on the OpenAI-compatible serving endpoint, independent corroboration of reliable tool execution.
